spec.query:
from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation_rolling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["request"] == "ALL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "response_time_p50")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation_rolling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["request"] == "ALL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "response_time_p90")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation_rolling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["request"] == "ALL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "response_time_p95")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["request"] != "all")
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value", "_time"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value / float(v: 30)) }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_field"])
  |> median(column: "_value")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "RPS")

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_field"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Total requests")

import "date"

windowEvery = 30s

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: date.sub(from: v.timeRangeStop, d: windowEvery))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "simulation", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: windowEvery, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) / (float(v: int(v: windowEvery)) / 1000000000.0) }))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Total Throughput (RPS)")

import "date"

windowEvery = 30s

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: date.sub(from: v.timeRangeStop, d: windowEvery))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "simulation", "_field", "host", "request"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: windowEvery, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) / (float(v: int(v: windowEvery)) / 1000000000.0) }))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Total Throughput (RPS)")

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "response_time")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "simulation", "_field", "host", "request", "Name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(
      every: 30s,
      fn: (tables=<-, column) =>
          tables
            |> quantile(
                q: 0.9,
                method: "estimate_tdigest",
                compression: 1000.0
            ),
      createEmpty: false
  )
  |> yield(name: "pct90")

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation_rolling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["request"] == "ALL")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "response_time_step_p90_avg")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation")
  // Шукаємо всі статус-коди помилок (4xx та 5xx) замість старого "ko"
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["status"] =~ /^[45][0-9]{2}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "simulation", "_field", "host", "request", "Name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Error Count")

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["status"] =~ /^[45][0-9]{2}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "count")
  // Залишаємо для групування лише необхідні мінімальні теги, включно зі статусом
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "simulation", "_field", "request", "status"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Error Count")

from(bucket: "gatling")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "gatling")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["simulation"] == "PerfTestSimulation")
  // Шукаємо всі статус-коди помилок (4xx та 5xx) замість старого "ko"
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["status"] =~ /^[45][0-9]{2}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "simulation", "_field", "host"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Error Count")
